name: 동남풍
description: Southeast Gale — silver-jade wind ribbons sweep the whole field from bottom-right to top-left (south-east wind); each enemy unit is caught in a small rising wind helix and whisked away toward the enemy hand
format: WebP sprite strip (lossy RGB + alpha), straight (non-premultiplied) alpha
card: cost 6 · wind · 적 전체 전장 유닛을 핸드로 이동 / 손패 10장 초과분은 파괴 (spell.type bounce_enemy_board)

unitImpact.anchor: each unit on the TARGET side (enemy board; my board when the AI casts)
unitImpact.delayFormula: delayMs = 0.25*((1920-unitX)+(1080-unitY)) - 250  (sweep from the bottom-right corner; clamp >= 0)

overlay.fit: stretch to the full 16:9 stage (1920x1080 at 1080p), top-left 0,0
overlay.note: drawn for my cast (wind blows toward the enemy side at the top); mirror vertically when the AI casts so it blows over my board
overlay.opacityNote: v0.371 game: overlay drawn at 72% alpha (Higgsfield note: original briefly covers the enemy row too heavily)

afterEffect: game removes the enemy units / adds them to the hand as usual; preview fades each unit out at its delay+220..400ms and grows the enemy hand at 560-820ms

sfx.source: fs2 C-style: synth low brown-noise rumble with rising low-pass (slow amplitude sway) + soft pitch-drop sub thump(s), layered with this concept's own Kling clip audio low-passed ~0.6-0.7 kHz; final low-pass 1.7/2 kHz
sfx.note: soft low wind swell, low thump as the wind catches the units, softer thump as they reach the hand
